name: WebCloner
author: Bikan

sections.description:
WebCloner allows you to import WordPress-compatible content packages generated by the WebCloner service into your WordPress website.

This plugin can import posts, pages, media files, categories, featured images, and related content contained within supported WebCloner export packages.

External Service Requirement

This plugin requires a WebCloner account and a content package generated through the WebCloner service.

WebCloner website: https://webcloner.tech

Privacy Policy: https://webcloner.tech/privacy

Terms & Conditions: https://webcloner.tech/terms

Features

  • Drag-and-drop package upload
  • Imports posts with titles, content, excerpts, and slugs
  • Uploads images and media files to the WordPress Media Library
  • Updates media references to local WordPress URLs
  • Sets featured images from imported content
  • Creates and assigns categories automatically
  • Preserves publication dates where available
  • Imports content as drafts for review before publishing
  • AJAX-powered import process with progress tracking
sections.installation:
1. Upload the webcloner folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Tools → WebCloner
  4. Upload a supported WebCloner export package and start the import process
sections.faq:
Where do I get a compatible import package?

Generate and download a WordPress-compatible export package from your WebCloner account at https://webcloner.tech.

Does this plugin require a WebCloner account?

Yes. This plugin imports content packages generated by the WebCloner service.

Will my existing content be overwritten?

No. Imported content is created as new draft entries. Existing content is not modified.

How long does the import take?

Import time depends on the size of the package and the number of media files included. Progress is displayed during the import process.

What happens if an import is interrupted?

You can restart the import using the same package. The plugin attempts to avoid importing duplicate content where possible.
